sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a distance D, computes a slab score, adds a 30-point bonus, and prints the total.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It scores 2 per unit to 20, then 4 per unit to 40. The next branch covers up to 60 but multiplies (D - 60) by 4, and only distances above 60 use 6 per unit.
